verses.text: Paul, a bond-servant of Christ Jesus, called [as] an apostle, set apart for the gospel of God,
verses.textZh: 耶穌基督的僕人保羅，奉召為使徒，特派傳神的福音。

verses.text: which He promised beforehand through His prophets in the holy Scriptures,
verses.textZh: 這福音是神從前藉眾先知在聖經上所應許的，

verses.text: concerning His Son, who was born of a descendant of David according to the flesh,
verses.textZh: 論到他兒子─我主耶穌基督。按肉體說，是從大衛後裔生的；

verses.text: who was declared the Son of God with power by the resurrection from the dead, according to the Spirit of holiness, Jesus Christ our Lord,
verses.textZh: 按聖善的靈說，因從死裡復活，以大能顯明是神的兒子。

verses.text: through whom we have received grace and apostleship to bring about [the] obedience of faith among all the Gentiles for His name's sake,
verses.textZh: 我們從他受了恩惠並使徒的職分，在萬國之中叫人為他的名信服真道；

verses.text: among whom you also are the called of Jesus Christ;
verses.textZh: 其中也有你們這蒙召屬耶穌基督的人。

verses.text: to all who are beloved of God in Rome, called [as] saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textZh: 我寫信給你們在羅馬、為神所愛、奉召作聖徒的眾人。願恩惠、平安從我們的父神並主耶穌基督歸與你們！

verses.text: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, because your faith is being proclaimed throughout the whole world.
verses.textZh: 第一，我靠著耶穌基督，為你們眾人感謝我的神，因你們的信德傳遍了天下。

verses.text: For God, whom I serve in my spirit in the [preaching of the] gospel of His Son, is my witness [as to] how unceasingly I make mention of you,
verses.textZh: 我在他兒子福音上，用心靈所事奉的神，可以見證我怎樣不住的提到你們；

verses.text: always in my prayers making request, if perhaps now at last by the will of God I may succeed in coming to you.
verses.textZh: 在禱告之間常常懇求，或者照神的旨意，終能得平坦的道路往你們那裡去。

verses.text: For I long to see you so that I may impart some spiritual gift to you, that you may be established;
verses.textZh: 因為我切切的想見你們，要把些屬靈的恩賜分給你們，使你們可以堅固。

verses.text: that is, that I may be encouraged together with you [while] among you, each of us by the other's faith, both yours and mine.
verses.textZh: 這樣，我在你們中間，因你與我彼此的信心，就可以同得安慰。

verses.text: I do not want you to be unaware, brethren, that often I have planned to come to you (and have been prevented so far) so that I may obtain some fruit among you also, even as among the rest of the Gentiles.
verses.textZh: 弟兄們，我不願意你們不知道，我屢次定意往你們那裡去，要在你們中間得些果子，如同在其餘的外邦人中一樣；只是到如今仍有阻隔。

verses.text: I am under obligation both to Greeks and to barbarians, both to the wise and to the foolish.
verses.textZh: 無論是希利尼人、化外人、聰明人、愚拙人，我都欠他們的債，

verses.text: So, for my part, I am eager to preach the gospel to you also who are in Rome.
verses.textZh: 所以情願盡我的力量，將福音也傳給你們在羅馬的人。

verses.text: For I am not ashamed of the gospel, for it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes, to the Jew first and also to the Greek.
verses.textZh: 我不以福音為恥；這福音本是神的大能，要救一切相信的，先是猶太人，後是希利尼人。

verses.text: For in it [the] righteousness of God is revealed from faith to faith; as it is written, 'BUT THE RIGHTEOUS [man] SHALL LIVE BY FAITH.'
verses.textZh: 因為神的義正在這福音上顯明出來；這義是本於信，以致於信。如經上所記：義人必因信得生。

verses.text: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,
verses.textZh: 原來，神的忿怒從天上顯明在一切不虔不義的人身上，就是那些行不義阻擋真理的人。

verses.text: because that which is known about God is evident within them; for God made it evident to them.
verses.textZh: 神的事情，人所能知道的，原顯明在人心裡，因為神已經給他們顯明。

verses.text: For since the creation of the world His invisible attributes, His eternal power and divine nature, have been clearly seen, being understood through what has been made, so that they are without excuse.
verses.textZh: 自從造天地以來，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，雖是眼不能見，但藉著所造之物就可以曉得，叫人無可推諉。

verses.text: For even though they knew God, they did not honor Him as God or give thanks, but they became futile in their speculations, and their foolish heart was darkened.
verses.textZh: 因為，他們雖然知道神，卻不當作神榮耀他，也不感謝他。他們的思念變為虛妄，無知的心就昏暗了。

verses.text: Professing to be wise, they became fools,
verses.textZh: 自稱為聰明，反成了愚拙，

verses.text: and exchanged the glory of the incorruptible God for an image in the form of corruptible man and of birds and four-footed animals and crawling creatures.
verses.textZh: 將不能朽壞之神的榮耀變為偶像，彷彿必朽壞的人和飛禽、走獸、昆蟲的樣式。

verses.text: Therefore God gave them over in the lusts of their hearts to impurity, so that their bodies would be dishonored among them.
verses.textZh: 所以，神任憑他們逞著心裡的情慾行污穢的事，以致彼此玷辱自己的身體。

verses.text: For they exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.
verses.textZh: 他們將神的真實變為虛謊，去敬拜事奉受造之物，不敬奉那造物的主；主乃是可稱頌的，直到永遠。阿們！

verses.text: For this reason God gave them over to degrading passions; for their women exchanged the natural function for that which is unnatural,
verses.textZh: 因此，神任憑他們放縱可羞恥的情慾。他們的女人把順性的用處變為逆性的用處；

verses.text: and in the same way also the men abandoned the natural function of the woman and burned in their desire toward one another, men with men committing indecent acts and receiving in their own persons the due penalty of their error.
verses.textZh: 男人也是如此，棄了女人順性的用處，慾火攻心，彼此貪戀，男和男行可羞恥的事，就在自己身上受這妄為當得的報應。

verses.text: And just as they did not see fit to acknowledge God any longer, God gave them over to a depraved mind, to do those things which are not proper,
verses.textZh: 他們既然故意不認識神，神就任憑他們存邪僻的心，行那些不合理的事；

verses.text: being filled with all unrighteousness, wickedness, greed, evil; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, malice; [they are] gossips,
verses.textZh: 裝滿了各樣不義、邪惡、貪婪、惡毒（或作：陰毒），滿心是嫉妒、兇殺、爭競、詭詐、毒恨；

verses.text: slanderers, haters of God, insolent, arrogant, boastful, inventors of evil, disobedient to parents,
verses.textZh: 又是讒毀的、背後說人的、怨恨神的（或作：被神所憎惡的）、侮慢人的、狂傲的、自誇的、捏造惡事的、違背父母的。

verses.text: without understanding, untrustworthy, unloving, unmerciful;
verses.textZh: 無知的，背約的，無親情的，不憐憫人的。

verses.text: and although they know the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, they not only do the same, but also give hearty approval to those who practice them.
verses.textZh: 他們雖知道神判定行這樣事的人是當死的，然而他們不但自己去行，還喜歡別人去行。
